row: The Forgotten Ones Animal Rescue is a 501(c)3 non-profit, foster-based animal rescue located in Midlothian, Texas. Our passion is helping animals that are injured or sick and suffering in the streets and our local shelters. Our dogs live in loving homes from the minute we get them.  All of our Foster Moms and Dads are volunteers.  They show them love, gain their trust, and make each dog a loving part of their family, until their forever family can be found. Come along with us and be part of their journey.
